FAQ.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.desc: Check out our FAQs on the best Web Development Course about course features, fees, scholarships, and much more.

FaqDATA.ques: Who is Skillslash? What do they do?
FaqDATA.ans: Skillslash is an ed-tech company that helps coders and working professionals build stronger careers across domains like Full Stack Web Development, Data Science, Business Analytics, and Blockchain. We focus on getting learners real, industry-recognised certification through actual work experience rather than just classroom theory, and we've designed each course curriculum around what companies are actually hiring for, at fees that stay accessible.

FaqDATA.ques: How will I benefit from industry mentors?
FaqDATA.ans: Our mentors have worked at top companies like Google, Amazon, and Meta, and they bring that industry experience into how they review your code and guide your progress. Alongside the technical training, you get the chance to work on live projects with real companies, which makes cracking MNC interviews a lot more manageable. The syllabus itself is built around helping you turn that practical exposure into genuine, job-ready skill.

FaqDATA.ques: Is any academic degree necessary to apply for a Web Development Course?
FaqDATA.ans: No, an academic degree isn't a strict requirement. This programme is built for working professionals and recent graduates, and freshers with basic coding skills are also welcome to apply. For professionals, we generally look for around a year of work experience, though a relevant academic degree is an added advantage. The course runs for 11 months, with scholarship concessions available.

FaqDATA.ques: What does Skillslash’s Web Development Course provide?
FaqDATA.ans: The course gives you real work experience through both offline and online learning options, including live, interactive sessions for a hybrid learning experience. You'll work directly on industrial coding projects offered by our partner firms, and the training covers all the core concepts at an affordable course fee. We also offer scholarships and concessions, with discounts on the course fee based on your scholarship test score - reach out to our consultants for more details on the program.

FaqDATA.ques: When can I start the course? What if I miss any of the sessions in the Full Stack Web Development online course?
FaqDATA.ans: You can start whenever the next cohort is available. All our classes are recorded, so if you miss a live session you can catch up on your own schedule without losing continuity - there's no extra fee for this beyond what's already included in the course.

FaqDATA.ques: What kind of certification does Skillslash’s Full Stack Web Development training provide?
FaqDATA.ans: You won't just get an academic certificate. Instead, you receive a globally recognised project-based certification, and if you work on live industrial projects, the partner company can issue you direct certification for that work too. The syllabus is kept aligned with the skills companies are actually looking for, so what you're certified in reflects real, current demand.

To qualify, you'll need to score at least 65% on our scholarship assessment, which gets you a 10% discount on the course fee. We also extend scholarships to unemployed candidates and to mothers returning to the workforce after a career break. Speak with our academic counsellor to learn more about the terms and conditions.

FaqDATA.ques: How many mock interviews and job referrals will I have throughout the Web Development training?
FaqDATA.ans: There's no fixed cap - we offer unlimited job referrals along with mentor support aimed at getting you into product-based firms. We'll keep running mock interviews with you until you're genuinely ready to present your projects and experience confidently. Since the syllabus is built around domain-specific skills, our instructors can also pinpoint your weak areas and work with you on those throughout the programme.

FaqDATA.ques: Which role will I be eligible for after completing a Web Development course online?
FaqDATA.ans: Once you finish the course, you'll walk away with a portfolio built to match what industries are actually looking for. Graduates typically get placed as Web Developers, Front End Developers, Back End Developers, or SDEs, with mentor guidance along the way to help you crack interviews at larger MNCs.

FaqDATA.ques: How will the doubts get resolved?
FaqDATA.ans: Since the cohorts run on weekends, we hold a dedicated doubt-clearing session every Wednesday in addition to regular class hours. Our 250+ problem-solving challenges also help reinforce your understanding as you go. Class sizes are kept small so instructors can actually review your progress individually - so if you're stuck on a Java problem, for instance, a mentor is there to help you through it.

FaqDATA.ques: What is the program duration for a Web Development online course?
FaqDATA.ans: The programme runs for 11 months, giving you enough time to build a solid grasp of the concepts and prepare for interviews at top companies like the MAANG firms. Experienced tutors guide you through it from the basics right up to an advanced level.

FaqDATA.ques: Is EMI payment acceptable in this Web Development institute?
FaqDATA.ans: Yes, Skillslash offers a no-cost EMI option, so there's no interest added through the repayment period. Payments can be spread out over up to 12 months, and the amount can be customised to suit your budget.

FaqDATA.ques: How will the classes be conducted? What are the course timings for Web Development course?
FaqDATA.ans: Classes are conducted live through our online learning platform by experienced mentors, and every session is recorded for later reference. The full programme spans 11 months to cover all the modules, and timings generally depend on cohort availability - most batches run on weekends.

FaqDATA.ques: What is the refund policy for Skillslash’s Web Development online training?
FaqDATA.ans: Refund requests are accepted within 15 days from the start of the course. If you haven't attended any classes and want a refund within that window, your request will be considered accordingly.
